summary: Tree-shaded riverside parking bay with no buildings nearby.
reasons: Open to the car park, level ground

best_section.where: Shaded bay at the end of the riverside car park off Meiers Road, under the big trees

drivers.seclusion: Trees on three sides and the river bank beyond; no mapped buildings.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park connects directly to the bay; a vehicle already sits at the west end and there is room for a van.
drivers.traffic: One-way riverside access road passes about 20 m north.
drivers.convention: Public free car park (access yes, fee no) with cars parked.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, 88 m from the Brisbane River
Mapped gate 162 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy, shaded most of the day.
